item.title: CHAOS;CHILD
item.description: From the creators of the critically acclaimed STEINS;GATE comes a sensational new visual novel: CHAOS;CHILD. Set in Shibuya in 2015, a group of high school students who survived an earthquake six years ago find themselves at the center of a new series of bizarre murders in the city.

item.title: CHAOS;HEAD NOAH
item.description: CHAOS;HEAD NOAH is now available on Steam!

item.title: Of Ash and Steel
item.description: Of Ash and Steel is an immersive third-person open-world RPG created by a passionate team that values the essence of classic old-school RPGs and modern design. Explore the lands of a once-prosperous island, hone your combat skills, and survive in the unforgiving realm of the Kingdom of the Seven.

item.title: STEINS;GATE 0
item.description: If you can't save the one you love… How can you save humanity? Sequel to the visual novel cult classic. Experience an alternate worldline of STEINS;GATE.

item.title: Unicycle Together
item.description: A unicycle, a bomb ready to blow, and sausages struggling to balance! Cooperate with your friends or blow them up in this 2-4 player physics-based chaos game! Reach the summit before the bomb goes off. Don't fall, don't explode, and try to stay a sausage!

item.title: Akatori
item.description: Akatori is an epic metroidvania where you wield your staff to fight, jump, and explore diverse realms across different eras. Explore worlds spanning different eras, battle formidable enemies, and help Mako stop the Amber Storms that poison all living things.

item.title: Cleaning Up The Puzzle Gallery
item.description: Cleaning Up The Puzzle Gallery is a cozy first-person organization simulator about cleaning up 2071 puzzle pieces scattered across a gallery of 87 famous paintings. Whether you want to relax and solve jigsaw puzzles to classical music, or min-max to get the fastest times, the gallery needs cleaning.

item.title: Emergency Call - The Firefighting Simulation 3
item.description: Be part of a professional fire department and prepare for your operations. Complete training courses and drills during your 24-hour shifts to qualify for roles from attack crew member to engineer across various emergency vehicles.

item.title: Garden Life: A Cozy Simulator
item.description: Garden Life is a relaxing gardening game in which you create your dream garden in a peaceful, colourful world. Plant and add ornaments at your own pace, transforming an overgrown forgotten plot into a flourishing community garden.

item.title: Gunstoppable
item.description: A momentum-fueled Roguelite FPS where speed is damage. Dual-wield overpowered weapon combos and bend time to obliterate robot hordes and overthrow billionaire bosses!

item.title: Moonlighter
item.description: Moonlighter is an Action RPG with rogue-lite elements that demonstrates two sides of the coin – revealing everyday routines of Will, an adventurous shopkeeper that secretly dreams of becoming a hero.

item.title: Ranchbound
item.description: Raise cattle, develop your ranch, hire cowboys, buy land, and invest in local businesses in a real-time economic strategy with survival challenges.

item.title: STEINS;GATE REBOOT DIGITAL DELUXE EDITION
item.description: STEINS;GATE returns! Rebooted for the modern era! Featuring fully updated visuals, UI, and an all-new story that breathes new life into the streets of Akihabara.

item.title: Stranded: Alien Dawn
item.description: Brave a new world in Stranded: Alien Dawn, a planet survival sim placing the fate of a small marooned group in your hands. Forge your story through compelling and immersive strategic gameplay as you make vital decisions to protect your survivors.

item.title: Stranded: Alien Dawn - Robots and Guardians
item.description: Expand your Stranded: Alien Dawn experience. After liberating Hope, the first sentient android, you are driven to refuge in the Outer Worlds. Make your stand against the ruthless manufacturing consortium attempting to destroy her before she achieves full sentience

item.title: Kynseed
item.description: Embark on a lifetime of adventure in a beautiful world of creativity and intrigue. Raise a family, customise your farm, run a business, craft items, and battle some marvellously malevolent monsters.

item.title: Lost & Found: A This Bed We Made Story
item.description: Lost & Found is a standalone, short story game taking place aboard a 1960s transatlantic ship. Play as Sophie Roy in her new job as a stewardess, and help solve a curious series of thefts in this narrative-driven mystery set after the events of This Bed We Made.

item.title: This Bed We Made
item.description: This Bed We Made is a third-person mystery game in which you play as a maid in a 1950s hotel and snoop around strangers' rooms to uncover their deadly secrets. Discover what links guests together in this tale of love, heartbreak and murder!

item.title: How Many Dudes?
item.description: How many dudes does it take to beat up a gorilla? A thousand toddlers? A horse-sized duck? A GOD? Enter the Dude Ranch and find out in this roguelike dudebuilder where you recruit an army of dudes to fight ridiculous battles.

item.title: Kill The Shadow
item.description: Kill the Shadow is a detective game with multiple endings, featuring 2.5D pixel art and semi-open exploration and investigation. Play as Lucas, a former police officer, alongside a mysterious Shadow who can see the “past.” Remember—every choice you make will change the fate of countless characters!

item.title: The Spell Brigade
item.description: Survivors-like with ONLINE CO-OP for 1-4 players. Team up with your wizard friends to slay hordes of dark creatures. Complete team-based objectives, unlock new upgrades and create overpowered spell synergies. Friend nor foe is safe in this friendly fire bullet hell!
